title: Human-in-the-loop manual routing
core_meaning: The advisor retains full context, a human approves one compact task card, and one lower-cost worker executes one bounded attempt.

states.label: NEUTRAL
states.descriptor: Full context held. No worker runs.
states.plain_english: The advisor session retains the full history while the trusted host withholds worker assignment.

screen_state.label: FULL CONTEXT
screen_state.meaning: The long conversation remains with the advisor.

states.label: APPROVE CARD
states.plain_english: The human reviews and approves the exact bounded card. Approval permits one assignment, not unlimited reuse.

screen_state.label: APPROVED CARD
screen_state.meaning: One compact task card is visible for human approval.

states.label: ENGAGED
states.plain_english: The trusted host sends the exact approved card to one qualified lower-cost worker for one bounded attempt.

screen_state.label: BOUNDED WORKER
screen_state.meaning: The worker receives the compact card, not the full conversation.

engagement_overlay.explanation: Only the lever, selector fork, and synchronizer engagement region comes from the edited source. Every frame otherwise reuses the same pinned base image.

thesis.headline: FULL HISTORY STAYS WITH THE ADVISOR. ONLY THE APPROVED TASK MOVES.
thesis.body: That limits worker context and moves routine labor to a lower-cost model. Failed checks return to neutral; retries need new approval. Verification and human acceptance still follow.
thesis.caveat: Savings vary; short tasks may not offset routing overhead.
thesis.efficiency_mechanism: The worker receives a compact approved card rather than the full conversation, reducing worker-context volume while routine execution moves to a lower-cost model.
thesis.neutral_definition: No worker is engaged while scope, approval, or retry is unresolved.
thesis.retry_rule: One card authorizes one attempt. A failed check returns to neutral and every retry requires a new card and human approval.
thesis.acceptance_rule: Verification informs later human acceptance; successful worker execution does not accept itself.

claim_ceiling: This is a control and cost-routing metaphor. It does not prove authenticated identity, secure isolation, correct model judgment, measured savings, or accepted output.
